title: Invariance of the query string
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a type, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean string. For any configuration $c$ of a machine with $k+1$ work tapes on input $x$, any tape contents $t\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and any integer head position $p$, inserting $t$ as the new work tape in the designated oracle-choice slot, with head position $p$, leaves the query string unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes over Bool on input $x$
$t$ is a tape from integer positions to optional Booleans
